items.title: File Einspruch against Kindergeld-Festsetzung
items.quote: Wer mit dieser Festsetzung nicht einverstanden ist, kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch bei der Familienkasse Musterrhein erheben – schriftlich, elektronisch über ELSTER oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 27.03.2025; assumed Aufgabe zur Post on that same day. Letter itself states Bekanntgabe fiction = 4th day after posting (not the usual §122(2) AO 3-day rule, but the 4-day rule applicable since 2025). Counting 27.03. as day 0: day 1 = 28.03 (Fri), day 2 = 29.03 (Sat), day 3 = 30.03 (Sun), day 4 = 31.03.2025 (Mon) → Bekanntgabe = 31.03.2025, a business day so no shift needed. Einspruchsfrist = 1 month after Bekanntgabe. Per §108 Abs.1 AO i.V.m. §187 Abs.1 BGB, the day of the event (31.03.) is not counted; period begins 01.04.2025. Per §188 Abs.2 BGB the one-month period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the event day (31), i.e. '31 April' — but April has only 30 days, so per §188 Abs.3 BGB the period ends on the last day of that month: 30.04.2025 (Wednesday). This day is not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday, so no further shift under §193 BGB.

items.title: Notify Familienkasse if Marlene stops or interrupts her studies
items.quote: Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Marlene das Studium abbricht oder unterbricht.
items.computation: This is an open-ended, continuing notification duty tied to a future event (end or interruption of studies), not a calendar date or a fixed period after the letter. No trigger date is stated in the letter, so no specific due date can be computed; the obligation simply applies whenever such an event occurs.

warnings: The letter uses placeholder/sample names and addresses (e.g. 'Musterausgabe', 'Beispielmainz', 'Musterschmidt'), suggesting this may be a template or specimen document rather than a genuine Bescheid — verify authenticity before acting on it.

The stated 4-day postal delivery fiction differs from the traditional 3-day rule under §122(2) AO; this was taken as stated in the letter but should be double-checked against the version of the law in force when the letter was actually issued.
